resolution: Updated cart/editor mesh shader ink pickers to match the world tile texture picker behavior: shader thumbnails are paged in the mesh picker, the armed shader exposes its authored variant/take chips, selecting a variant rebuilds the brush ink data with Color Studio palette overrides, and clicking the same shader preserves the selected take. Added a small shared shaderPick helper for variant data packing/inference used by both toolbar and dock pickers.
